packageRules.description: @uniswap/token-lists 1.0.0-beta.35 was published with a broken tarball (no dist/ directory in the published package). Pin to beta.34 until upstream republishes.

react-scripts 5.0.1 ships resolve@1.x which cannot resolve TypeScript 7's exports-only ESM package.json, so the build crashes with MODULE_NOT_FOUND before Webpack starts. Pin to the 4.9.x range until react-scripts is replaced.
